Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b][color=#93c47d]NOTE:[/color][/b] In this mod, Alex is written as an emotionally intelligent, mature adult in his mid-20s. This mod is fun, light, and positive escapism. If you are looking for a more immature, rude, angsty, or dark take on Alex, there are several yandere mods out there that follow this type of path. No single mod can meet every taste, so variety is good!

[color=#93c47d][size=4]IMPORTANT! Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.
Updating: delete the old Magg’s Immersive Alex folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Follow Alex on his journey to discover what he really wants to do with his life as he grows from his high school gridball dreams to discover all the possibilities available to him.
Alex starts out as his usual gridball-obsessed and oblivious self, focused only on his single dream. Over the year, more of Alex's personality and true feelings are revealed through conversations, fun and serious events, cutscenes, and dialogue from other characters. Alex loves more than just gridball, he is passionate about his family, concerned for his future, and unsure how to let go of his past so he can be free to move forward. Dealing with a painful past, letting go of old dreams, and taking risks are major themes. Your choice of Sweet, Spicy, or Extra Spicy variations, see descriptions below.

[b][size=4]Dialogue[/size][/b]

[*]Nearly a full replacement of Alex's vanilla dialogue along with a massive expansion. Includes unique dialogue for Alex nearly every day the first year. Additional 10-heart dialogue plus some dated lines if you choose to date into the second year.[/*]
[*]Greatly expanded and randomized marriage dialogue.[/*]

The configuration settings include an option to disable the custom sprites, which will show alternate (less immersive) visuals and disables a few minor cutscenes that are dependent on the sprites. See the Events article for details.
See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2862]FAQ/Info[/url] article for more details.

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Assumptions[/b][/size][/color]
You are planning to date/marry Alex. If not, you will miss out on a lot of the content. This mod is a story of forming a close relationship with Alex through the first year with a lot of dated dialogue, but the romance is heart/relationship status based so you can set your own pace. Rushing means you won’t see all the lines, so generally plan to hit 8 hearts around mid-fall or later. None of the dialogue is required to see, but it does progress the story. Talk to Alex and Haley (see the FAQ link below for unique dialogue dates for Haley) every day if possible for full content.
Go here and scroll below the FAQ to find pacing recommendations: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2862]FAQ/Info[/url]

[b][color=#93c47d][size=4]Sweet, Spicy, or Extra Spicy, which to choose?[/size][/color]
[/b]
[b]SWEET[/b]
Is it getting a little too “steamy” in here? Feeling a bit “overheated”? Curl up with your fluffy bunny slippers and enjoy your Alex with whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry on top!
[list]
[*]0-8 hearts: see Alex grow in his relationships with family and friends, make connections with other NPCs in the valley.[/*]
[*]Haley also has a growth arc, including events just for her and farmer.[/*]
[*]10 hearts and marriage: cute and romantic conversations.[/*]
[*]NO swearing[/*]
[*]Events do not emphasize Alex's difficult vanilla backstory.[/*]
[/list]
[b]SPICY[/b]
Want your Alex with a little kick but not quite at the heat level (or strangeness level) of a few other mods out there? Give our hunky gridballer a little spice. I mean, you don’t expect him to ALWAYS keep his hands to himself, do you?
[list]
[*]0-8 hearts: see Alex grow in his relationships with family and friends, make connections with other NPCs in the valley.[/*]
[*]Haley also has a growth arc, including events just for her and farmer.[/*]
[*]10 hearts and marriage: blatant innuendo, sexual references, very leading dialogue. You’re seriously dating/married so it makes sense. Nothing crass or graphic, all healthy and romantic.[/*]
[*]Occasional mild swearing, PG-13[/*]
[/list][b]Content warning:[/b] references to past domestic violence. About the same level as the vanilla game. The conversation is very high level, no details and should not be an issue for most people.

[b]EXTRA SPICY[/b]
Is it getting hot in here? Spicy with additional sexual content and dialogue. Still leaves some things to the imagination, but definitely turns up the heat from Spicy.  Don’t expect yandere content or anything overly explicit or crass, that’s not my style.
[list]
[*]0-8 hearts: see Alex grow in his relationships with family and friends, make connections with other NPCs in the valley.[/*]
[*]Haley also has a growth arc, including events just for her and farmer.[/*]
[*]10 hearts and marriage: blatant innuendo, sexual references, very leading dialogue. You’re seriously dating/married so it makes sense. Nothing crass or graphic, all healthy and romantic, but fairly steamy at times. Descriptions are very leading (Some in dating, much more in marriage). Body parts are occasionally mentioned based on gender, but not in an overly descriptive way.[/*]
[*]Occasional mild swearing, suggestive slang. PG-13 (no f-bombs, sorry, not sorry! I just don’t think it’s necessary)[/*]
[*]Two exclusive events[/*]
[/list][b]Content warning:[/b] references to past domestic violence. About the same level as the vanilla game. The conversation is very high level, no details and should not be an issue for most people.

[b][color=red][size=4]Permissions[/size][/color][/b]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. I worked heckin’ hard on this mod, it’s my baby and I would hate to see it uploaded by someone who didn’t do the work.
[b]Translation: [/b]Please message me to let me know you want to translate. I will tell you if anyone else has already started a translation in your language and answer any questions you might have.
[b]Modders:[/b] You may use this file as an example of 1.6 code formatting as a reference only, do not copy my dialogue. If you have questions, feel free to message me.
[b]Streamers:[/b] Feel free to stream this mod, just add a link back here for download and credit. Highly recommended to stream Sweet or Spicy, but not Extra Spicy unless your audience is GUARANTEED to be over 18 and you have at least looked at the dialogue to see what you’re getting into. Please message me if you have any questions or concerns.
